title: JKSSB MTS / Class-IV & Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026 - 2863 Posts
qualificationText: MTS: Matric (10th) to 10+2. Sanitation Worker: 8th Pass to 10+2
salary: Pay Level SL1: Rs 14,800 - Rs 47,100 per month
shortInfo: JKSSB has invited online applications for 2,863 Class-IV (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts across UT, Divisional and District cadres under Advertisement No. 09 of 2026. The last date has been extended to 27 November 2026. Only J&K domicile holders can apply.
eligibilityNotes:
Must be a Domicile holder of the Union Territory of J&K with a valid Domicile Certificate on or before the cut-off date.
Qualification must match the post: MTS needs Matric (10th) to 10+2; Sanitation Worker needs 8th Pass to 10+2. Other qualifications are not eligible.
Age is counted as on 01.01.2026. Upper limit: 40 years (OM), 43 years (SC, ST-1, ST-2, OBC, RBA, ALC/IB, EWS), 42 years (PwBD).
Only one application per item number is allowed. Multiple applications for the same item number lead to cancellation.
selection:
Objective type written test (MCQ, English only). Negative marking: one-fourth of the marks of each wrong answer is deducted.
Final merit = written test marks + additional weightage, then document verification.
UT Cadre: written 85 + no family member in govt service 5 + widow/divorced/orphan girl 5 + casual worker (5+ years) 5 = 100.
Divisional Cadre: written 80 + home division 5 + the three 5-mark claims = 100.
District Cadre: written 75 + home district 10 + the three 5-mark claims = 100.
Cadre and department are allocated on merit-cum-preference basis.
howToApply:
Visit www.jkssb.nic.in once the application window opens
Register or log in on the online portal
Fill in personal, educational and category details carefully
Upload live photograph and signature (10 KB to 20 KB each)
Pay the fee online (Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card)
Review everything, then submit. No corrections are allowed after submission
Save and print the application for document verification
documents:
Original and self-attested copies of the online application and all certificates
Valid Domicile Certificate (J&K)
Educational certificates (Matric / 8th / 10+2 as applicable)
Category / reservation certificate, if applicable
Two recent passport-size colour photographs (not older than 6 months) and a valid photo ID
Weightage certificates (no government family member, widow/divorced/orphan, or casual-worker status), if claimed

title: JKSSB Junior Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2026 - 458 Posts (Jal Shakti & PWD R&B)
qualificationText: 3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering, or Degree in Civil Engineering, or AMIE Section A & B
salary: Pay Level-6: Rs 35,400 - Rs 1,12,400 per month plus allowances
shortInfo: JKSSB has invited online applications for 458 Junior Engineer (Civil) posts in the UT Cadre: 282 in the Jal Shakti Department (Item No. 266) and 176 in the Public Works (R&B) Department (Item No. 267), under Advertisement No. 11 of 2026. Applications run from 30 November to 29 December 2026. Selection is by an objective OMR-based written test. Only J&K domicile holders can apply.
eligibilityNotes:
Must be a domicile of the UT of J&K with a valid Domicile Certificate issued on or before 29.12.2026.
Qualification (any one): 3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering from a government-recognised institute, Degree in Civil Engineering from an Indian university, or AMIE Section A & B (India). It must be obtained on or before 29.12.2026. The Board may ask for an equivalence certificate.
Age is counted as on 01.01.2026. Upper limit: 40 years (OM, not born before 01.01.1986), 43 years (SC, ST-1, ST-2, OBC, RBA, ALC/IB, EWS, not born before 01.01.1983), 42 years (PwBD, not born before 01.01.1984). Not born after 01.01.2008.
Ex-Servicemen: period of military service is deducted from actual age, subject to the notification's maximum age condition.
Apply for Item No. 266 (Jal Shakti), Item No. 267 (PW R&B), or both, setting preferences if applying for both.
Vacancies may increase or decrease, and the recruitment is subject to any pending court cases.
selection:
Objective-type (MCQ) written / OMR examination, English only. Negative marking: one-fourth of the marks for each wrong answer.
Selection is on the merit of the written examination only, followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates. No interview.
Number of questions, total marks, duration, exam date and centres will be notified separately by JKSSB. The syllabus is also yet to be notified.
howToApply:
Visit www.jkssb.nic.in and open Advertisement Notification No. 11 of 2026
Register or log in on the online portal from 30 November 2026
Enter name, date of birth, father's and mother's names exactly as in the Matriculation Certificate
Select Item No. 266 (Jal Shakti) and/or Item No. 267 (PW R&B) and set preferences
Upload live photograph and signature (10 KB to 20 KB each), category certificate (PDF, max 200 KB) and qualification certificates (self-attested PDF, max 200 KB)
Pay the fee online (Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card)
Review everything, then submit. Corrections may not be allowed after submission
Save and print the application. Do not send a hard copy unless instructed. In-service candidates must apply through their Head of Department
documents:
Diploma / Degree / AMIE certificate
Matriculation Certificate (proof of name and date of birth)
Valid Domicile Certificate (J&K)
Category / reservation certificate, if applicable
Printed copy of the submitted application and original photo ID proof
Two recent passport-size colour photographs (not older than 6 months, bearing the date)
Bonafide Certificate for degrees from non-J&K universities (except Central Universities), if applicable
Ex-Servicemen certificate (Form-XIV) and affidavit, if applicable

title: JKSSB Junior Engineer (Mechanical) Recruitment 2026 - 127 Posts (PWD R&B)
qualificationText: 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, or AMIE Section A & B
salary: Pay Level-6: Rs 35,400 - Rs 1,12,400 per month plus allowances
shortInfo: JKSSB has invited online applications for 127 Junior Engineer (Mechanical) posts in the Public Works (R&B) Department, UT Cadre (Item No. 265), under Advertisement No. 10 of 2026. Applications run from 16 November to 15 December 2026. Selection is by an objective OMR-based written test followed by document verification. Only J&K domicile holders can apply.
eligibilityNotes:
Must be a domicile of the UT of J&K with a valid Domicile Certificate issued on or before 15.12.2026.
Qualification (any one): 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a government-recognised institute, Degree in Mechanical Engineering from an Indian university, or AMIE Section A & B (India). It must be obtained on or before 15.12.2026.
Age is counted as on 01.01.2026. Minimum 18 years. Upper limit: 40 years (OM), 43 years (SC, ST-1, ST-2, OBC, RBA, ALC/IB, EWS), 42 years (PwBD).
Ex-Servicemen: period of military service is deducted from actual age, within the 3-year tolerance of the notification.

selection:
Objective-type (MCQ) written / OMR examination, English only. Negative marking: one-fourth of the marks for each wrong answer.

Upload live photograph and signature (10 KB to 20 KB each) and PDFs (up to 200 KB) as required
Pay the fee online (Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card)
Submit, note the application number and save a printout. Do not send hard copies to the Board

title: SKUAST Jammu Recruitment 2026 - 3 Accounts Assistant / Cashier Posts
board: SKUAST-Jammu (Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology of Jammu)
qualificationText: Graduation with 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) from a recognised university. Post Graduate with 50% marks or PhD also eligible.
salary: Training stipend Rs 6,000/month for 1 year, then Pay Level-5: Rs 29,200 - Rs 92,300
shortInfo: SKUAST-Jammu (Chatha Campus) has invited online applications for 3 posts of Accounts Assistant/Cashier (2 Open Merit, 1 SC) under Advertisement No. 10 (Secy.) of 2026. Selection is by a 100-mark written examination only. Selected candidates first undergo a one-year training (Rs 6,000 per month) and are then placed in Pay Level-5. Only J&K domicile holders can apply.
eligibilityNotes:
Must hold a valid J&K UT Domicile Certificate issued on or before the last date of online application.
Graduation (any stream) from a recognised university: minimum 50% marks for Open Merit, 45% for reserved categories. Post Graduates with 50% marks and PhD holders are also eligible.
The qualification must be held on or before the last date of online application. Degrees from universities declared fake by UGC are not accepted.
Equivalent qualifications need an equivalence certificate from the competent authority at document verification; the University's decision is final.
Age is counted as on 01.01.2026: 18-40 years (OM), 18-43 years (reserved categories), 18-42 years (PwBD), 18-50 years (in-service employees of J&K State Universities).
Ex-Servicemen: military service is deducted from actual age; allowed up to 3 years above the upper limit. Candidate should not have been born after 01.01.2008.
Selected candidates must qualify the ACC examination during probation within the prescribed time; otherwise future increments are stopped until it is passed.
selection:
Written examination only (100% weightage): 100 marks, 2 hours. No separate interview weightage is mentioned.
The detailed syllabus is given in Annexure-I of the official advertisement.
Training: selected candidates undergo a one-year training course - first 6 months theoretical, next 6 months practical - on a stipend of Rs 6,000 per month.
After successful completion of training they are granted Pay Level-5 (Rs 29,200 - Rs 92,300).
howToApply:
Visit the official website skuastjammu.ac.in and open the Recruitment / Requirement Notices section
Read Advertisement No. 10 (Secy.) of 2026 carefully, including Annexure-I (syllabus)
Register and fill in the online application form from 16 November 2026
Upload the required documents
Pay the fee online (Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card) - fee is non-refundable and non-adjustable
Submit the application by 15 December 2026 and save a printout
In-service candidates must also send their form through proper channel so that it reaches the Registrar, SKUAST-Jammu, Main Campus, Chatha, Jammu, PIN 180009 by 14 January 2027
Apply early - heavy traffic near the last date can cause technical problems
documents:
Valid J&K Domicile Certificate (issued on or before 15-12-2026)
Graduation / Post Graduation / PhD degree and marksheets (50% for OM, 45% for reserved)
Category / reservation certificate, if applicable (SC, PwBD etc.)
Equivalence certificate, if claiming an equivalent qualification
Ex-Servicemen service proof, if claiming age relaxation
No-objection / proper channel forwarding for in-service candidates
Photo ID proof, recent photograph and signature
Note: the complete document and upload checklist is in the official notification

title: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 - 1053 Banking Associate & Probationary Officer Posts
qualificationText: Graduation in any discipline (degree or marksheet needed by 26-11-2026)
salary: BA: Rs 24,050 basic. PO: Rs 48,480 basic
shortInfo: J&K Bank has released two notifications for 1,053 posts: 1,033 Banking Associate posts (J&K UT domicile) and 20 Probationary Officer posts (Ladakh UT domicile). Both use the same application and fee window, which closes on 26 November 2026.
eligibilityNotes:
Banking Associate: J&K UT domicile with a valid domicile certificate.
Probationary Officer: Ladakh UT domicile.
Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university. Final-year students who will not finish by 26-11-2026 are not eligible. CGPA/OGPA must be converted to a percentage as per the university formula.
Age: 20 to 30 years as on 01.01.2026, before relaxation.
Banking Associate reservation: SC 8%, ST 10% (existing) + 10% (newly added), OBC 8%, ALC/IB 4%, RBA 10%, EWS 10%, Ex-Servicemen 6% and PwBD 4% (horizontal).
Probationary Officer (Ladakh) reservation: SC 1%, ST 80%, residents of areas adjoining ALC 4%, EWS 10%, PwBD 4% (horizontal).
A category certificate is needed at online registration if you claim reservation.
selection:
Banking Associate: one online exam conducted by IBPS (100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes, English, negative marking 1/4), then provisional selection and document verification. No interview. Minimum qualifying marks: 40% (General) and 35% (reserved). Former J&K Bank apprentices with J&K domicile get 2.5 extra marks.
Probationary Officer: Preliminary online exam, Main exam (objective + descriptive essay/comprehension), then a 100-mark interview. Final merit = 80% Main + 20% Interview. Preliminary marks are used only for shortlisting.
howToApply:
Visit the official website jkb.bank.in (Careers section) from 7 November 2026
Register and log in
Fill in the online form, including graduation percentage
Upload photograph, signature and other documents as asked
Pay the fee online (Debit / Credit Card, Net Banking, IMPS or wallet)
Submit the application and save a printout
documents:
Graduation degree certificate or marksheet (valid by 26-11-2026)
Valid domicile certificate: J&K UT for Banking Associate, Ladakh UT for Probationary Officer
Category certificate, if claiming reservation (needed at registration)
Photo ID proof and a recent photograph and signature

title: RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 - 1265 Posts (CEN 08/2026)
qualificationText: Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university (must be completed by 25-11-2026)
shortInfo: Indian Railways, through the Railway Recruitment Boards, has opened online applications for 1,265 Station Master posts under CEN 08/2026. Vacancies were corrected from 1,215 to 1,265 by Corrigendum No. 1 dated 27-10-2026. Apply at rrbapply.gov.in by 25 November 2026 (11:59 PM). You can apply to only one RRB.
eligibilityNotes:
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from a recognised university, completed by 25-11-2026. Candidates awaiting final results are not eligible.
Age: 20 to 33 years as on 01-01-2027. Relaxation: OBC-NCL 3 years, SC/ST 5 years, and other government rules.
Must meet the A-2 medical standard for Station Master.
Candidates must apply to only one RRB. Multiple applications may lead to rejection.
selection:
Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 questions, 100 marks, 120 minutes. Negative marking: 1/3 mark per wrong answer.
CBT sections: Basic Science, Mathematical & Analytical Capability (60 Q), Logical Capability (20 Q), Mental Reasoning (20 Q).
Then Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), document verification and medical examination.
Final merit: 70% CBT + 30% CBAT.
howToApply:
Visit rrbapply.gov.in
Click Create an Account (new) or Already Have an Account (login)
Complete account verification and enter personal details
Fill in educational qualification and category details
Select the Railway Recruitment Board and your preferences carefully
Upload live photograph, signature and documents as the portal asks
Review all details and submit
Pay the exam fee online
Download and print the application form
documents:
Live photograph and signature, as per portal instructions
Bachelor's degree / marksheets
Category or concession certificate, if claimed
Registered mobile number and email ID for login and OTP
